title: Dinosaurs and Roman battles on Benowitz's CRT

tellings.quote: Gabe told me he went over there and saw some of it. He said they were dinosaurs and like old like Roman battles and stuff,

plain: Between 1980 and 1983, pictures of dinosaurs and old battles that looked Roman are said to have appeared on a CRT, an old-style tube computer screen, in the Albuquerque home of a man named Benowitz. A guest, Greg Bishop, tells it on the show as something he heard from a man named Gabe Valdez, who told Bishop he went over to the house and saw some of it himself. If true, it would mean the screen was showing scenes no ordinary signal would explain.
